Subject: Intro / Redwood quick discovery - Acme Apps

Hi Sam —

Great to meet you and the Acme Apps team on the call today. Quick recap and the proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard:
- Primary use case: in-product assistant for support triage + summarization (~300k users/week).
- Key constraints: sub-100ms p50 for short queries, strict data retention for EU logs, SSO + SCIM.
- Current pain: expensive per-token costs and unreliable response times at scale.

What Redwood can provide (high-level):
- Dedicated inference pools for predictable latency and cost.
- Prefix caching and batching to lower token costs on recurring queries.
- Private deployment option for restricted data + KMS integration.

Next steps we agreed on: 
1) I'll share a short mutual action plan (attached) and a one-pager with pricing ranges.
2) Vivek will join a technical deep dive to cover SSO/SCIM and network topology if you want to proceed.
3) You'll follow up with any red flags on compliance or timeline constraints.

Proposed times for the technical deep dive: Wed 5/14 or Thu 5/15, 10-11am PT. If neither works, suggest a couple times.

Attachments:
- redwood-quickstart.pdf (one-pager)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level milestones + owners)

If I don't hear back on timings, I'll follow up next week. Thanks again for your time — excited to explore this with you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — good conversation. Appreciate the summary and attachments.

Two quick questions from our side as we prep internally: 
1) Can you share a ballpark pricing range for a setup that serves ~2M tokens/day with a mix of short (chat) and medium (summaries) responses?
2) For compliance, what's the default data retention and can we get an option to disable long-term retention for our EU tenants?

We're aiming to decide on a vendor by end of June, and I'll loop in our security lead if you can share the retention details. Also, 5/14 is ok for a technical deep dive — let's tentatively lock it and I'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Hi Sam — thanks for the quick reply and the timeline context. Answers below and a few asks to keep things moving: 

Pricing (ballpark) for ~2M tokens/day (mix of short + medium):
- Hosted API: $0.045-$0.07 per 1k input tokens, $0.06-$0.09 per 1k output tokens (higher variance due to burst). Estimated monthly ~$6k-$12k depending on output ratio and caching.
- Dedicated (reserved): starts at ~$35k/mo for committed pool that matches your throughput needs; effective per-token cost goes down with caching and batching.

Data retention / compliance:
- Default: 30 days of short-term logs, 13 months of audit metadata.
- We can offer retention-cut policies per region for Dedicated or Private deployments — e.g., disable long-term retention for EU tenant data. Vivek can provide details in the technical deep dive and map to SCIM/KMS controls.

Next asks: 
- Can you confirm who from security will join (name/email)?
- Does 5/14 10am PT still work for the deep dive?

I'm attaching the mutual action plan again; Vivek, can you prepare a short slide on SSO/SCIM, private deployment options, and retention controls?

Thanks — I'll hold 5/14 10am PT tentatively.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:
